documentation.file_docstring: Golden trace models and YAML persistence for regression testing.
member_docstrings: TraceSource: Origin of a golden trace.
GoldenTrace: A captured trace marked as the expected-correct 'golden' reference.
GoldenTraceResult: Outcome of running a single golden trace against an agent function.
GoldenSuiteResult: Aggregate outcome of running an entire golden-trace suite.
GoldenTraceSuite: A named collection of golden traces with a CI pass threshold.

to_yaml: Serialize the suite to a YAML file.
from_yaml: Deserialize a suite from a YAML file.
